title: Triage Compass: Session-based Failed-Request Navigator & Annotated Payload Lens
creator: Nora Chen
description: Design and prototype a unified triage surface — 'Triage Compass' — that helps engineers debug failed requests by session, visualize retry chains, inspect annotated payloads, and map failures to an error taxonomy. The goal is to reduce mean time to resolution for customer incidents and to provide clear handoffs between console, SRE, and engineering teams.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity prototype (Figma) of the main Triage Compass surface with session grouping, retry chain timeline, and payload lens
Annotated payload viewer that highlights mutated fields, sensitive fields redaction state, and linkouts to the eval harness
Error taxonomy overlay that maps each failed attempt to a canonical error class and shows similarity scores
Interaction spec for quick actions: replay request, open raw payload, create incident, pin snapshot, and open PR template
Design handoff doc with token/latency cost overlay rationale and accessibility notes
design_notes: Surface organizes by session ID first, then groups by client request fingerprint (to collapse noisy duplicates).
Retry chain is a horizontal swimlane. Attempts are shown with duration bars, status icons, and causal arrows where available.
Payload Lens shows three synchronized panes: parsed payload, diffs across retries, and inferred schema with sensitive-field annotations.
Error taxonomy is derived from runtime classifier (heuristic + ML) and surfaced as color bands; clicking band filters timeline to matching attempts.
Include 'confidence' badge for taxonomy mapping and a link to raw model explanation (for ML-derived classifications).
Quick-actions include 'Replay with debug headers', 'Export snapshot', 'Add to evaluation suite', and 'Create runbook entry'.
Privacy: payload viewer must respect data retention and redaction policies; include an inline lock icon with KMS indicator if payload decrypted for viewing.
Performance: timeline must lazy-load long sessions and provide sampling mode for >10k events.
Cost overlay: optional toggle to show token-level cost and per-attempt GPU usage estimate based on model variant metadata.
Mobile: prioritize read-only condensed view with shareable deep link to full console entry for pager workflows.
design_decisions: Group by session ID vs by endpoint: chose session-first to preserve causal context for multi-request flows (e.g., chat sessions).
Show diffs across retries rather than raw side-by-side payloads to quickly surface mutated fields that may cause retries.
Use color-coded taxonomy bands instead of textual tags in timeline to avoid clutter and make pattern recognition easier.
Expose confidence metric on ML-derived tags to prevent blind trust and prompt operator verification.
Place quick-actions in a persistent sticky toolbar so operators can act at any scroll position during triage.
